import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

NAME = "pullback within relative trend 26s4 + rev4"
IDEA = "Cross-sectional rank of vol-adjusted 26w-skip4 relative momentum plus rank of the negative vol-adjusted last-4w relative return: buy pullbacks in relative uptrends, fade bounces in downtrends."


def signal(px: pd.DataFrame, bench: pd.Series, bars) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rs = px.div(bench, axis=0)
    lr = np.log(rs.where(rs > 0))
    vol = lr.diff().rolling(26, min_periods=20).std()
    vol = vol.where(vol > 0)
    mom = (lr.shift(4) - lr.shift(26)) / (vol * np.sqrt(22.0))
    rev = -(lr - lr.shift(4)) / (vol * 2.0)
    valid = mom.notna() & rev.notna()
    mom = mom.where(valid)
    rev = rev.where(valid)
    r_mom = mom.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    r_rev = rev.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    out = r_mom + r_rev
    return out.reindex_like(px)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

NAME = "52w-high anchor skip4 + continuity + pullback"
IDEA = "Rank-sum of vol-scaled distance of the relative ratio (lagged 4w) from its 52w high, frog-in-pan continuity of the 26s4 trend, and negative last-4w relative return: anchored, smooth relative trends with a recent dip outperform."


def signal(px: pd.DataFrame, bench: pd.Series, bars) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rs = px.div(bench, axis=0)
    lr = np.log(rs.where(rs > 0))
    dlr = lr.diff()
    vol = dlr.rolling(26, min_periods=20).std()
    vol = vol.where(vol > 0)
    lr4 = lr.shift(4)
    hi52 = lr4.rolling(52, min_periods=40).max()
    prox = (lr4 - hi52) / (vol * np.sqrt(13.0))
    mom = lr4 - lr.shift(26)
    rev = -(lr - lr4) / (vol * 2.0)
    have = dlr.notna()
    pos = (dlr > 0).astype(float).where(have)
    neg = (dlr < 0).astype(float).where(have)
    pos_f = pos.shift(4).rolling(22, min_periods=18).mean()
    neg_f = neg.shift(4).rolling(22, min_periods=18).mean()
    cont = -np.sign(mom) * (neg_f - pos_f)
    valid = prox.notna() & rev.notna() & cont.notna()
    prox = prox.where(valid)
    rev = rev.where(valid)
    cont = cont.where(valid)
    r_prox = prox.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    r_rev = rev.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    r_cont = cont.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    out = r_prox + r_rev + r_cont
    return out.reindex_like(px)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

NAME = "volume-conditioned pullback + continuity 26s4"
IDEA = "Frog-in-pan 26s4 relative momentum + continuity, plus a 4w reversal leg weighted up when the recent move came on low dollar volume vs own history and down on heavy volume."


def signal(px: pd.DataFrame, bench: pd.Series, bars) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rs = px.div(bench, axis=0)
    lr = np.log(rs.where(rs > 0))
    dlr = lr.diff()
    vol = dlr.rolling(26, min_periods=20).std()
    vol = vol.where(vol > 0)
    mom = (lr.shift(4) - lr.shift(26)) / (vol * np.sqrt(22.0))
    rev = -(lr - lr.shift(4)) / (vol * 2.0)
    have = dlr.notna()
    pos = (dlr > 0).astype(float).where(have)
    neg = (dlr < 0).astype(float).where(have)
    pos_f = pos.shift(4).rolling(22, min_periods=18).mean()
    neg_f = neg.shift(4).rolling(22, min_periods=18).mean()
    cont = -np.sign(mom) * (neg_f - pos_f)

    v = bars.volume.reindex(index=px.index, columns=px.columns)
    c = bars.close.reindex(index=px.index, columns=px.columns)
    dv = (v * c)
    dv = dv.where(dv > 0)
    dv_recent = dv.rolling(4, min_periods=3).mean()
    dv_base = dv.shift(4).rolling(26, min_periods=20).mean()
    vsurp = np.log(dv_recent / dv_base)

    valid = mom.notna() & rev.notna() & cont.notna()
    mom = mom.where(valid)
    rev = rev.where(valid)
    cont = cont.where(valid)
    vsurp = vsurp.where(valid)

    r_mom = mom.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    r_rev = rev.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    r_cont = cont.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    vr = vsurp.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    w = (1.5 - vr).fillna(1.0)
    out = r_mom + r_cont + r_rev * w
    return out.reindex_like(px)

"""The one file a research run may edit. See research/RULES.md.

signal(px, bench, bars) returns a frame shaped like px. Higher must mean "expected to
outperform the benchmark over the next 1-3 months". See RULES.md for the full contract.
Only information up to and including each row's date may be used.
"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

NAME = "daily continuity + pullback 26s4"
IDEA = ("Rank-sum of vol-adjusted 26w-skip-4w relative momentum, the consistency of that trend "
        "measured on daily relative returns over the same window, and the negative last-4w move.")


def signal(px: pd.DataFrame, bench: pd.Series, bars) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rs = px.div(bench, axis=0)
    vol = np.log(rs).diff().rolling(26, min_periods=20).std()
    mom = np.log(rs.shift(4) / rs.shift(26)) / vol
    pullback = -np.log(rs / rs.shift(4))

    # Continuity: share of up-days minus down-days in daily returns relative to the benchmark,
    # over roughly the same 26-to-4-week window, signed by the trend's direction. Many small
    # steady moves score high; a trend made of a few jumps scores low.
    d = bars.daily.close
    rel = np.log(d[px.columns].div(d[bench.name], axis=0)).diff()
    updown = np.sign(rel).where(rel.notna())
    frac = updown.rolling(110, min_periods=80).mean().shift(20)
    cont = np.sign(mom) * frac.reindex(px.index, method="ffill")

    rank = lambda f: f.where(px.notna()).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    return (rank(mom) + rank(cont) + rank(pullback)).where(mom.notna() & cont.notna() & pullback.notna())

"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

NAME = "capitulation minus blow-off days 20d"
IDEA = ("Count of capitulation days (wide-range down day, heavy volume, closing in the upper half "
        "of its range) minus blow-off days (the mirror image) over the last 20 sessions.")


def signal(px: pd.DataFrame, bench: pd.Series, bars) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = bars.daily
    c, h, l, v = (f[px.columns] for f in (d.close, d.high, d.low, d.volume))
    prev = c.shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([h - l, (h - prev).abs(), (l - prev).abs()]).groupby(level=0).max()
    atr = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean().shift(1)          # yesterday's ATR, so today's bar can stand out
    wide = tr > 2 * atr
    heavy = v > 2 * v.rolling(50, min_periods=40).median().shift(1)
    pos = (c - l) / (h - l).where(h > l)                          # 0 = closed at the low, 1 = at the high
    move = np.log(c / prev)

    capit = (wide & heavy & (move < 0) & (pos > 0.5)).astype(float)
    blowoff = (wide & heavy & (move > 0) & (pos < 0.5)).astype(float)
    score = (capit - blowoff).rolling(20, min_periods=15).sum().where(atr.notna())
    return score.reindex(px.index, method="ffill").where(px.notna())

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

NAME = "close location vs price move 63d"
IDEA = ("Volume-weighted average of where each day closes in its range (buying pressure), minus "
        "what the name's own price move would predict: steady closes near the highs without the "
        "price having run yet suggest accumulation ahead of outperformance.")


def signal(px: pd.DataFrame, bench: pd.Series, bars) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = bars.daily
    c, h, l, v = (f[px.columns] for f in (d.close, d.high, d.low, d.volume))
    clv = ((c - l) - (h - c)) / (h - l).where(h > l)            # -1 closed at the low, +1 at the high
    w = v / v.rolling(63, min_periods=45).mean()
    pressure = (clv * w).rolling(63, min_periods=45).sum() / w.rolling(63, min_periods=45).sum()
    pw = pressure.reindex(px.index, method="ffill").where(px.notna())
    ret = np.log(px.div(bench, axis=0) / px.div(bench, axis=0).shift(13))
    rank = lambda f: f.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    return (rank(pw) - rank(ret)).where(pw.notna() & ret.notna())

import numpy as np

NAME = "lottery top-5 average 21d"
IDEA = ("Against names whose five biggest daily moves relative to the benchmark in the last month "
        "averaged highest: a less noisy version of the single-day max.")


def signal(px: pd.DataFrame, bench: pd.Series, bars) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = bars.daily.close
    rel = np.log(d[px.columns].div(d[bench.name], axis=0)).diff()
    a = rel.to_numpy()
    out = np.full(a.shape, np.nan)
    for i in range(20, len(a)):
        w = a[i - 20:i + 1]
        n = np.sum(~np.isnan(w), axis=0)
        top = -np.sort(-np.where(np.isnan(w), -np.inf, w), axis=0)[:5]
        out[i] = np.where(n >= 15, top.mean(axis=0), np.nan)
    top5 = pd.DataFrame(out, index=rel.index, columns=rel.columns)
    return -top5.reindex(px.index, method="ffill").where(px.notna())

"""Pre-registered 2026-10-25, test Q3. See research/prereg/README.md. Scored once; never edited."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

NAME = "Q3 pullback-in-trend within Lagging and Improving"
IDEA = ("Among names left of centre (Lagging or Improving) only, for a steady 26w-skip-4w relative "
        "trend that dipped over the last 4 weeks: a pullback in an intact trend marks a bottom.")

def quadrant(px, bench):
    """The page's weekly RRG quadrant: 0 Leading, 1 Weakening, 2 Lagging, 3 Improving."""
    sm = (100 * px.div(bench, axis=0)).ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean()
    rsr = 100 * sm / sm.rolling(10).mean()
    rsm = (100 * rsr / rsr.shift(1)).ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean()
    q = np.where(rsr >= 100, np.where(rsm >= 100, 0, 1), np.where(rsm >= 100, 3, 2)).astype(float)
    return pd.DataFrame(q, index=px.index, columns=px.columns).where(rsr.notna() & rsm.notna())


def rel_daily(px, bench, bars):
    d = bars.daily.close
    return np.log(d[px.columns].div(d[bench.name], axis=0)).diff()


def weekly(f, px):
    return f.reindex(px.index, method="ffill").where(px.notna())


def signal(px, bench, bars):
    rs = px.div(bench, axis=0)
    vol = np.log(rs).diff().rolling(26, min_periods=20).std()
    left = quadrant(px, bench).isin([2, 3])
    mom = (np.log(rs.shift(4) / rs.shift(26)) / vol).where(left)
    pullback = (-np.log(rs / rs.shift(4))).where(left)
    ok = mom.notna() & pullback.notna()
    rank = lambda f: f.where(ok).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    return ((rank(mom) + rank(pullback)) / 2).where(ok)
